meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可管理作者习惯、启动本地 Dashboard。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写网络小说时自动匹配趁手工具,并记住你的写作习惯
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在写网络小说,希望工具顺着你的习惯走
copy.tagline_en: Auto-match the right writing tools and remember your habits as you draft web novels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want tools that adapt to your habits

howto.what: 它接管网文工具箱的入口:按你的意图把请求转发到写长篇、写短篇、拆文等具体技能,也能管理作者习惯、启动本地工作台、检查版本更新。
howto.when: 输入 /story、$story 等命令,或说「我想写小说」等话术时触发。未指明长篇短篇会先问再路由。

say.note: 会先问长篇还是短篇,再路由到对应技能
启动本地 Dashboard,返回本机地址

say.text: 记住我的写作习惯:少用感叹号
say.note: 写入工作区作者记忆,收到回执才算成功

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into the entry point of a web-novel toolbox: it routes your request to skills for long or short writing, breakdowns and more, and manages author habits, a local dashboard and version checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /story, $story and similar commands, or phrases like "I want to write a novel". Long or short form is asked first if unclear.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel
say_en.note: Asks long or short form first, then routes
Starts the local dashboard and returns its URL

say_en.text: Remember my writing habit: fewer exclamation marks
say_en.note: Writes to workspace author memory after a receipt
